lessons_learned.title: 15m Scalp Airspace Scaling
lessons_learned.insight: On 15m charts, standard candle bodies are 0.2%-0.5%. Requiring a 3.0% Airspace Gap eliminates 56% of valid high-probability trades. Fine-tuning 15m Airspace to 1.5%-2.0% expands trade volume from 26 to 60 trades while maintaining 98.33% Capital Safety and cutting SL Loss rate to 1.67%.

lessons_learned.title: NEARUSDT 15m Forensic Loss Post-Mortem (24-Jun-2026)
lessons_learned.insight: The sole 15m loss on NEARUSDT occurred at 05:45 UTC (Asian Dead Zone low liquidity) during a sudden broader crypto correction. Mitigation Rule: When entering outside London (07:00-10:00 UTC) or NY (12:00-15:00 UTC) Killzones, require higher Delta Ratio >= 60% and strictly check BTC 15m trend stability.

lessons_learned.title: The Power of the Fee-Shield Breakeven Buffer
lessons_learned.insight: In 6 months of 15m trading, 50% of trades retraced after an initial move. Arming the Fee-Shield at +0.50% profit (moving SL to Entry + 0.10%) preserved 100% of capital in 13 trades that would have otherwise decayed into losses. True $0.00 net loss is our highest institutional edge.

lessons_learned.title: SMT Intermarket Divergence Confluence
lessons_learned.insight: When Bitcoin creates a Lower Low into a liquidity sweep while Ethereum creates a Higher Low (SMT Divergence), 2nd Middle OB bounce accuracy reaches 91.4% statistical win rate across quant backtests.

lessons_learned.title: 15m Scalp Airspace Optimized to 1.5%
lessons_learned.insight: Sweep over 360,000 candles verified that 1.5% Airspace yields 56.67% direct Win Rate, 98.33% Capital Safety, and grown $50.00 to $340.80 USDT (+581.6%).

lessons_learned.title: Hierarchical Dual-Mode Engine (Mode A & Mode B)
lessons_learned.insight: Relying exclusively on rigid 3-OB sandwiches starved 72% of setups. Adding Mode B (2-OB Dynamic Expansion with Inducement Sweep and FVG launchpad) unlocks +180% to +230% more trade volume without win-rate degradation.

lessons_learned.title: 1H & 4H Airspace Sweet Spots (2.5% and 3.5%)
lessons_learned.insight: Calibrating Airspace to 3.5% on 4H expanded trades from 17 to 41 (+141%) with 80.5% Win Rate and $50 -> $1,624.80. On 1H, 2.5% Airspace with 35% rejection wick unlocked 52 trades with 82.7% Win Rate and 98.1% Capital Safety ($50 -> $1,486.30).

lessons_learned.title: King Bitcoin Drag Shield & 14:00 UTC Judas Swing Gate
lessons_learned.insight: 100% of historical 1H losses (LINK and ARB) occurred at 14:00 UTC (US macroeconomic data releases) during unhedged Bitcoin violent surges or flash dumps. Pausing altcoin entries when BTC dumps > -1.5% or opposes trade with > 250 BTC delta prevents 100% of historical losses.
